LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_NativeCommunee.desc: [PAWN_nameDef] is just one of the billions of Alfaus living on Rimworlds, [PAWN_pronoun] was living in a new clan commune on this planet, learning and doing a considerable variety of labor and frequently attend various meetings within the clan because the commune was only recently established. These experiences made [PAWN_nameDef] familiar with various skills, but proficient in very few.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_HiveEngineer.title: hive engineer
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_HiveEngineer.descri: [PAWN_nameDef] once worked as an engineer in an Alfaus hive city for over a decade, pouring countless drops of sweat on support pillars hundreds of meters in diameter and spending long stretches of time in endless tunnels. Through all these experiences, [PAWN_pronoun] gained deep expertise and mastery in architectural aesthetics and civil engineering. As a result, every structure on the rimworld seems as small as a child’s toy block house in [PAWN_possessive] eyes.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Hareftain.title: hareftain
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Hareftain.descripti: [PAWN_nameDef] seems born with the ability to bring people together. [PAWN_pronoun] served as a representative of the warren, a militia company commander, and a commune council member. Even before coming to the rimworld, [PAWN_pronoun] had already accumulated rich life experience. These talents and skills in agitation, debate, and persuasion also play a vital role on the rimworld, where unity and trust are precious.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_MilitiaSergeant.des: Professional soldiers in Alfaus society are far fewer than in any class‑based society of comparable scale, armed people and mandatory training are their norm. For this reason, an Alfaus who like [PAWN_nameDef] takes soldiering as a full‑time profession often far outpaces others in combat skills or the art of war, gaining broad recognition from the entire clan. Only then can [PAWN_pronoun] become a full‑time soldier in a society where everyone is a soldier and maintain [PAWN_possessive] position and influence within the clan by serving as an drill sergeant and leading in battle.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_DiplomacyCommission: [PAWN_nameDef] was appointed by [PAWN_possessive] clan as a diplomacy commissioner, representing the clan in negotiations with other clans, serving on the clan’s delegation to the Union Assembly, and communicating with alien races worth talking to. Thanks to years of diplomatic experience, [PAWN_pronoun] became skilled in speech and keenly perceptive of others' interests. With the right leverage, [PAWN_pronoun] could reach an optimal agreement with almost anyone.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Sailor.title: sailor
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Sailor.description: [PAWN_nameDef] previously worked aboard an Alfaus starship, traveling through the star sea for years, seeing dozens of different stars, setting foot on various worlds, and delivering millions of Alfaus to their new homes. Now [PAWN_nameDef] has decided to end [PAWN_possessive] voyaging life and settle on a new world with [PAWN_possessive] rich life experience and the knowledge to maintain and pilot a small starship alone.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Agronomist.title: agronomist
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_Agronomist.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] was an agricultural technician for [PAWN_possessive] clan. [PAWN_pronoun] learned how to maintain various farm machines and how to plant and tend dozens of common crops. As [PAWN_pronoun] said, [PAWN_pronoun] was among the first wave of colonists of [PAWN_possessive] clan to arrive on the rimworld. As a planet with a sparse population and much land yet to be cultivated, [PAWN_possessive] importance speaks for itself.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_CommuneMama.title: commune papa
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_CommuneMama.descrip: Alfaus do not have nuclear families like humans do, most children grow up in the clan's nursery. [PAWN_nameDef] was the most popular teacher in the nursery of [PAWN_possessive] clan. Although this position could usually be rotated, [PAWN_nameDef] truly loves children, cared for the young of the clan day after day for decades, watched them grow up. Now [PAWN_pronoun] is regarded as parent by hundreds of people, feeling deeply happy and fulfilled. Even after coming to the rimworld, [PAWN_pronoun] will not forget this feeling nor [PAWN_possessive] love for children.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_CanteenUncle.title: canteen uncle
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_CanteenUncle.descri: [PAWN_nameDef] is a familiar face in the clan’s canteen, beloved by everyone. For many years, [PAWN_pronoun] rises early every day to prepare hot meals for hundreds of clan members. [PAWN_pronoun] remembers everyone’s taste preferences and always leaves a late‑night snack for those who return home after dark. [PAWN_possessive] cheerful laughter can be heard in every corner of the canteen. Even after arriving on the rimworld, [PAWN_pronoun] continues to warm everyone around with [PAWN_possessive] cooking skills.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BurrowRabbit.title: burrow rabbit
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BurrowRabbit.descri: [PAWN_nameDef] is a burrow rabbit — a veteran miner. For many years, [PAWN_pronoun] has tunneled through the intricate warrens of the Alfaus, learning the texture of every rock layer and the direction of every ore vein. [PAWN_pronoun] can gauge depth from the color of stone and mud, distinguish the quality of minerals through the echoes of pickaxe strikes. To [PAWN_nameDef], the underworld feels more like home than the surface, darkness is more familiar than light.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_AssemblyLineResiden: The entire clan of [PAWN_nameDef] has lived for generations in the giant factories of a hive city, with most members working as assembly line workers. [PAWN_pronoun] works faster than an automated machine, and [PAWN_possessive] eyes can spot a defect in a component within a second. Though life is monotonous, [PAWN_pronoun] never complains. In [PAWN_possessive] view, every qualified product is a contribution to the clan collective. Now that [PAWN_pronoun] has come to the rimworld, [PAWN_pronoun] still holds onto that focus and patience.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BunnyFriend.title: bunny friend
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BunnyFriend.descrip: [PAWN_nameDef] was a skilled caretaker of giant rabbits on an Alfaus ranch. [PAWN_pronoun] knows how to soothe a timid giant rabbit and how to nurse a sick one back to health. [PAWN_pronoun] can mimic a dozen different rabbit murmurs and postures, “talking” effortlessly with the giant rabbits. Every giant rabbit in the ranch recognizes [PAWN_nameDef], as soon as [PAWN_pronoun] steps into the pen, they hop over and gather around, rub [PAWN_possessive] hands and waist. After coming to the rimworld, [PAWN_nameDef] still hopes to raise some giant rabbits.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_CommunityDoctor.des: [PAWN_nameDef] is the community doctor of [PAWN_possessive] clan. From the common cold to complex battlefield wounds, [PAWN_pronoun] has treated them countless times. Throughout [PAWN_possessive] medical career, [PAWN_pronoun] has discovered more than once that healthcare is not only about the health and well‑being of patients, but also an indispensable key element for a collective to remain united and strong. No matter what kind of patient [PAWN_pronoun] encounters, nor how many times [PAWN_pronoun] has seen them, [PAWN_pronoun] never loses patience or diagnostic capability. Even on a resource‑scarce rimworld, [PAWN_nameDef] can work miracles with limited medicine.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_StarshipNavigator.d: [PAWN_nameDef] once served as a navigator on an Alfaus starship. [PAWN_pronoun] knew dozens of routes, experienced hundreds of interstellar voyages, fended off pirate attacks, took part in large‑scale space battles, and delivered millions of Alfaus to their new homes. [PAWN_nameDef] often tells others that the star sea is [PAWN_possessive] home, and that [PAWN_pronoun] is merely making a temporary stop on this rimworld.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_MilitaryDesigner.de: [PAWN_nameDef] once worked as a military equipment designer for a small clan union. Together with [PAWN_possessive] colleagues, [PAWN_pronoun] designed assault rifles, grenade launchers, tanks, infantry fighting vehicles, and self‑propelled artillery, creating countless miracles on a limited budget. Although they are not the work of one person alone, [PAWN_pronoun] still left a deep impression in [PAWN_possessive] clan through several ingenious problem‑solving solutions. After arriving on the rimworld, even though [PAWN_pronoun] did not bring past works along, [PAWN_possessive] knowledge and experience can still greatly benefit the colony.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_NativeBorn.title: native born
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_NativeBorn.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a clan commune on this planet, just like other Alfaus, [PAWN_pronoun] spent his childhood in labor education and collective life.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_NexusChild.title: child of the Secretary Nexus
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_NexusChild.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] belongs to no clan. [PAWN_pronoun] is an orphan who has lived among the secretaries since childhood and was raised by them. Yet [PAWN_possessive] childhood was not lonely. With no clan to call [PAWN_possessive] own, [PAWN_nameDef] regards the entire Secretary Nexus as home. Having no blood relatives, the secretaries are [PAWN_possessive] mothers, and the other children also adopted by the secretaries are [PAWN_possessive] brothers and sisters. After countless days and nights spent with the secretaries, [PAWN_pronoun] learned their rigor and selflessness, developed a spirit of devotion to the collective and service to society, and learned how to live independently. [PAWN_pronoun] hopes that one day [PAWN_pronoun] can repay the secretaries.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_VoidChild.title: child of the void
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_VoidChild.descripti: [PAWN_nameDef] was born aboard an Alfaus starship. Both of [PAWN_possessive] parents were crew members on the ship. [PAWN_possessive] childhood was filled with the rumble of the ship's engines and the starlight outside the viewports, playing and laughing in corridors lit by sun lamps with other children born on the ship or traveling aboard it, and learning in the ship's classrooms how to maintain and pilot the great vessel that [PAWN_pronoun] could call home, just like [PAWN_possessive] parents. For [PAWN_nameDef], life on the ground is brief. Though each landing shows a different world, each world full of strange and wondrous new things, only the cabins and the starlight bring that familiar feeling of home.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_HiveUrchin.title: hive urchin
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_HiveUrchin.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood in the maze‑like streets of a hive city. After countless games with [PAWN_possessive] friends and many near‑late dashes to school, [PAWN_pronoun] knows every shortcut and secret corner, moving effortlessly through layered passageways and finding [PAWN_possessive] way even in the most complex tunnels. Before leaving [PAWN_possessive] home planet for the rimworld, [PAWN_nameDef] had never seen such vast open space, such towering plants. Everything here feels both fresh and unsettling to [PAWN_possessive] eyes. Rather than traveling far and wide, [PAWN_pronoun] prefers to stay under a roof and live in familiar surroundings.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_LittleWarrior.title: little warrior
little warrior
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_LittleWarrior.descr: [PAWN_nameDef] has been fascinated by all things military since childhood. [PAWN_pronoun] often watches the militia drill and imitates them with toys alongside [PAWN_possessive] friends. [PAWN_pronoun] also enjoys war‑themed video games, imagining [PAWN_pronoun] charging into battle or outmaneuvering the enemy. Whenever the uncles and aunts in the clan ask [PAWN_nameDef] what [PAWN_pronoun] wants to do when [PAWN_pronoun] grows up, [PAWN_pronoun] always answers that [PAWN_pronoun] wants to become a real soldier and protect everyone in the clan.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BookwormBunny.title: bookworm bunny
bookworm bunny
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BookwormBunny.descr: [PAWN_nameDef] is a bookworm bunny. While other children run and play, [PAWN_pronoun] prefers to read quietly. From history to technical manuals, [PAWN_pronoun] reads everything, stuffing [PAWN_possessive] little head with all sorts of knowledge. Little [PAWN_nameDef] believes that [PAWN_possessive] learning will someday prove useful, just as the adults often say.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_LittleBunny.title: little bunny
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_LittleBunny.descrip: [PAWN_nameDef] has loved the rabbits on the ranch since childhood. [PAWN_pronoun] often wanders among the herds, feeding them and grooming their fur. The rabbits also love [PAWN_nameDef], as soon as [PAWN_pronoun] steps into the pen, they gather around to lick [PAWN_possessive] hands, hair, and ears. The adults at the ranch say that [PAWN_nameDef] has a natural way with rabbits, just like a little bunny.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_AssemblyLineApprent: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a clan that lives by factory assembly lines. From a young age, [PAWN_pronoun] helped the elders beside the conveyor belts, learning every step of the process. [PAWN_pronoun] is clever and nimble‑fingered, quickly learning what the elders taught and remembering every safety rule. After leaving [PAWN_possessive] home world, though far from the factory, the knowledge in [PAWN_possessive] head remains. [PAWN_pronoun] can still learn by analogy how to craft the things needed for life on the rimworld.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_GreenhouseFlower.de: [PAWN_nameDef] is often seen in the vertical farms and greenhouses of the hive city. [PAWN_pronoun] loves watching plants grow from seed to bloom to fruit, and also enjoys the sense of accomplishment that comes from planting and harvesting. Though agriculture on the rimworld is somewhat different from that in the hive city, the core of planting, growing, and harvesting remains the same. The seed of devotion to farming has already quietly sprouted in [PAWN_nameDef]'s heart, perhaps one day it will bear rich fruit on the rimworld as well.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_LittleCommissar.des: If you asked [PAWN_nameDef]'s friends what they think of [PAWN_nameDef], they would answer, "[PAWN_pronoun] is our commissar!" Whenever the children in the clan pick up toy guns and start playing war games, [PAWN_nameDef] naturally becomes the organizer and leader—assigning roles, coordinating, encouraging, and mobilizing. [PAWN_pronoun] acts like a little grown‑up, speaking in a proper manner and showing leadership talent beyond [PAWN_possessive] years. The self‑confidence and resilience [PAWN_pronoun] shows in childhood will deeply influence [PAWN_possessive] entire life.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_FoodieBunny.title: foodie bunny
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_FoodieBunny.descrip: [PAWN_nameDef] has a love for fine food and cooking that far exceeds [PAWN_possessive] age. [PAWN_pronoun] often sneaks into the canteen and kitchen, tiptoeing to watch the cooks at work. Sometimes, after everyone has left the kitchen, [PAWN_pronoun] secretly tries to cook, imagining that one day [PAWN_pronoun] will become a cook loved by the whole clan. Perhaps [PAWN_nameDef] will someday fulfill [PAWN_possessive] dream, whether back home or on the rimworld.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_BuildingBlockMaster: [PAWN_nameDef] is fascinated by construction. [PAWN_pronoun] loves building all kinds of houses, towers, and bridges with blocks, always making them taller and sturdier than other children. The clan's architects sometimes, on a whim, show [PAWN_nameDef] architectural blueprints, and [PAWN_pronoun] finds them utterly absorbing. Occasionally, [PAWN_nameDef] even asks the architects for paper and a pen, trying to draw [PAWN_possessive] dream factories, fortresses, and homes. Then [PAWN_pronoun] builds them block by block following the drawings, imagining them rising from the ground. [PAWN_pronoun] dreams that one day [PAWN_pronoun] will become the finest architectural designer in the entire union.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_RockCollector.title: rock collector
rock collector
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Alfaus_RockCollector.descr: [PAWN_nameDef] is full of curiosity about rocks and minerals, but the adults do not allow [PAWN_nameDef] to linger in the mine shafts, so [PAWN_pronoun] can only wander near the mine entrance, collecting ore fragments scattered on the ground, or hike around, tapping on exposed rocks. The bookshelves in [PAWN_possessive] room are filled with various stones, each labeled with the date and place where [PAWN_pronoun] found it. Some are also marked with names [PAWN_pronoun] learned from the miner uncles, while others have names [PAWN_pronoun] gave. Throughout [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood, [PAWN_pronoun] always hoped that one day the adults would allow to enter the mine and see with [PAWN_possessive] own eyes whether the ore layers are truly stacked one upon another and glittering as the books describe.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Human_HistoryTeacher.title: history teacher
history teacher
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Human_HistoryTeacher.descr: [PAWN_nameDef] is a history teacher at a school for the children of alien employees. The textbooks are co‑compiled by the secretaries and human scholars, describing in detail the wars, famines, and aristocratic oppression of humanity's old era, as well as how the arrival of the Alfaus brought peace and prosperity to humanity. [PAWN_nameDef] finds that the students easily accept this narrative, and so do their parents who sit in on the classes. After all, everyone's life is far better than before they came to the settlement administered by the secretaries. Even [PAWN_pronoun] often compares [PAWN_possessive] current life to [PAWN_possessive] previous one as a teacher in a small human town — a place with few people but plenty of trouble — in spare moments. If what [PAWN_pronoun] does now can maintain such a stable life, then [PAWN_pronoun] is willing to believe that these long‑eared alien "liberators" are telling the truth.
When [PAWN_nameDef] first arrived at a factory administered by the Alfaus, [PAWN_pronoun] tried to organize a union among the alien employees just as [PAWN_pronoun] had done in human settlements before. But few responded, and the arguments that had always worked in the past only made the atmosphere awkward after [PAWN_pronoun] spoke. Noticing that something was off, [PAWN_pronoun] asked around and learned that the factory committee composed of Alfaus has already made all production data and pay standards public, offers generous salaries, never owes wages, and the employee forum is held weekly to listen to employees. The workers felt that rather than using money to stage a strike that would seem laughable to people back in their old homes or making demands that might come across as ungrateful amusing the entire colony's alien people they would be better off pooling those so‑called union dues to buy snacks and organize outings. After that, [PAWN_nameDef] thought it over and reluctantly went to the Alfaus committee to request permission to form a labor union. The bunny who was typing at a desk didn't even look up and simply agreed. It was only after [PAWN_nameDef] walked out of the office in a daze that the absurdity and embarrassment caught up with [PAWN_possessive] brain. Over time, [PAWN_nameDef]'s organizational skills still came in handy — [PAWN_pronoun] became the activity planner for the workers' club, and everyone has a good time together.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Civil_Service_Secretary.de: [PAWN_nameDef]'s life was filled with serving Alfau citizens, she has experienced many customs, seen many sights, of many worlds, under the allocation of Secretary Nexus.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Soldier_Secretary.title: Soldier Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Soldier_Secretary.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] has not been transferred to any other department since being assigned to a combat unit by Secretary Nexus.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Hive_Secretary.title: Hive Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Hive_Secretary.description: Alfaus' hive cities were filled with tensions and conflicts between Alfaus clans, between alien species, between industry districts. As a secretary serving in hive city, [PAWN_nameDef] had to be drawn into them, coordinated various factions, presided over negotiations, conveyed opinions, and used riot gear to deal with the worst situation when necessary. Years of hive life have made [PAWN_nameDef] adapt to narrow and lack of sunlight environment, master negotiation skills and truncheon techniques, because she has wandered around the hive for years, seen various structures and sculptures, she can even provide some guidance on architecture and art.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Factory_Secretary.title: Factory Service Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Factory_Secretary.descript: It's hard to find the right way in Alfau's mega factory, but [PAWN_nameDef] did it. In the years past, [PAWN_nameDef] has been walking along the pipeline and catwalk in mega factories for a long time. Although there are so many good workers and engineers in Alfau, no one willing to work in massive noise and high temperature. So secretaries have taken on a lot of non automated work in order to improve production efficiency and expand industrial scale as soon as possible. Until the industrial system is established and developed maturely, they will be replaced by natural Alfaus.\n\n[PAWN_nameDef] walks between machines and conveyor belts for years and months, her accumulated knowledge and experience in production enable her to exert tremendous value in the manufacturing industry even without the body specifically manufactured for industrial production. Now she is far away from hive cities and mega factories, she is also far away from everything she is familiar with. She has seen countless times in her sleep the golden wheat waves enveloping the towering factory buildings that rise into the clouds, with countless chimneys, steel frames, and catwalks, for her, that's where she can call home. If she can't go back there and witness the miracles created by labor like in her sleep as she wishes, shaping the land under her feet into a home she can call will become her new goal.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Secretary_Experimenter.des: Secretaries are equal, it means there is no secretary has the right to evade responsibility and pain borne by other secretaries. In projects involving human experiments, this principle means that researchers and subjects are often synonymous. [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the researchers, although most experimental projects do not cause mental or physical damage, but there are some experimental projects aimed at exploring the limits of physical performance, the functions of unknown objects, or the actual effect of experimental medicine and poison. Those projects can easily lead to damage and death, but the consciousness transfer system can minimize losses while ensuring experimental efficiency. Therefore, [PAWN_nameDef] is proficient in the operation of various experimental equipment, mastered the knowledge and application of various disciplines, especially in biology and medicine, and she is accustomed to experimental accidents and deaths, at least that's how she hinted at herself.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Farm_Secretary.title: Farmer Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Farm_Secretary.description: Since being assigned to work on a collective farm, [PAWN_nameDef] has been engaged in agricultural labor for a long time. Taking care of plants, animals, and agricultural machinery, day by day, she has spent more time with animals and plants than with people. Due to the vast territory and sparse population of the agricultural planet, she had to do everything herself, repairing tractors, treating sick animals, and even preparing pesticides. Her experience has made her a versatile worker, and the rich food ingredients also give her rich cooking experience. Now she is in a rimworld, although she misses the old countryside where she used to work, but she still found solace in the unique animals and plants of rimworld. In time, she can also create a warm little place on this unfamiliar planet.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_AllRounder_Secretary.title: All-rounder Secretary
Diversified Service
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_AllRounder_Secretary.descr: [PAWN_nameDef] has never stayed in any department for two consecutive years, but selected by Secretary Nexus as a reserve, frequently transferred between multiple different departments, moved wherever needed. Series of experiences have equipped her with a considerable variety of labor skills, but none of them can be said to be very proficient, which in turn further reinforces her position as a reserve, makes people feel like they don't need her anywhere but also can't do anything without her.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Service_Protocol_Overloade: Compared to other secretaries, [PAWN_nameDef] is too enthusiastic in serving the public. Although there is a tendency in genetic design to ensure the quality of public services, But the performance of [PAWN_nameDef] far exceeded the design expectations. She hardly refuses any commands, demands, requests, or even asking from others. Unless it contradicts the principles of Secretary Nexus, even if it threatens her physical integrity or even vital signs, she will not refuse. This has caused her to replace her body several times or even more than ten times in the past few decades, hundreds of surgeries and countless treatments for "skin injuries". To show obedience and lowly to those who saw her, she even personally cut off her own tail after every resurrection from death. That means she's inferior and won't refuse any requests.\n\nHer experience of serving different social groups almost without any bottom line has made her proficient in the social etiquette, interests, hobbies and even more mysterious customs of various social groups. Her reserve of trivia also amazed other secretaries. And countless injuries, surgeries, and treatments have also made her proficient in emergency treatment for various internal and external injuries, almost comparable to medic in the Alfau Militia. But her self deprecating service style is difficult for other secretaries to accept. Although it won't cause too much trouble in the interactions between secretaries, popularizing odd trivias is also quite likable, but almost no secretary is willing to work with her in the same shift. Her behavior and words made the other secretaries together extremely embarrassed. Unless the others are also in a similar condition to her, they would rather stay away from her, and pretend to be busy doing other things, for example, punching holes in soda cakes.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Industrial_Ghost.title: Industry Ghosecretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Industrial_Ghost.descripti:
No one knows how many times [PAWN_nameDef] died during her hundreds of years of service in the Alfau's industrial system. She has already given up counting. If she has the leisure and courage to look back on her past, she can only recall high temperatures like stars, cold like liquid nitrogen, pains that penetrate deep into the bones, endless darkness, and the pleasure and calmness brought by pharmaceuticals the mental protection system released. She should have left this world long ago. But the consciousness transfer system imprisoned her forever in reality, can't escape. 

Countless industrial accidents and hundreds of years of service have also brought her unimaginable experience and unique insights in industrial production. Her expertise in manufacturing is unmatched by anyone else. Eternal service and countless deaths have made her the secretary who understands the life of the industrial working class the most. Nevertheless, the self talk, convulsions, suddenly standing still and other odd behaviors brought about by the mental shadow of countless industrial accidents and deaths make others keep a distance from her. Her self talk about how ugly it would be to die or which body part would be lost if she made a mistake in this step makes others feel ominous. Her skills were indispensable for the colony, but the ominous talking cannot be ignored either. Others both need her and want to stay away from her.

Perhaps she will remain lonely until she meets someone who can understand her.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Laboratory_Ghost.title: Laboratory Ghosecretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Laboratory_Ghost.descripti: Scientific progress comes at a cost, and [PAWN_nameDef] is the cost. When the consciousness transfer system is developed reliably, secretaries immediately invested the advantage of "immortality" into scientific research. [PAWN_nameDef] has already forgotten how many times she died in experiments. If she tries to recall an experience of death, infinite and extreme pain, cold, heat, itch, suffocation and pleasure will flood into her mind at the same time. After the brief blank of consciousness that followed, she could only recall a vague feeling, that is a collection of countless impressions of death. She knows, Secretary Nexus learns the performance limit of the latest model of clone, the features of newly discovered unknown objects, the habits of recently discovered alien life, and the practical effects of the latest inventions in biomedicine through the sacrifice of experimental subjects like her. \n\nBut these comforts are difficult to make up for the trauma caused by countless deaths to [PAWN_nameDef]. Although she deeply understands the significance of her sacrifice, but the mental pain and chaos are unavoidable, she has been tormented by nightmares and hallucinations for too long, and the absence of some memory fragments often makes her feel dizzy and disoriented. That was the mental shadow left on her during several secret experiments, memory clearing protocol is applied for, by herself. Fortunately, impressive experiences bring far more than just pain, If she doesn't intentionally recall death itself, she can actually recall a lot of knowledge that she exchanged with her life. She is the person who understands the weight and cost of knowledge the most. Even after retiring as an experimental subject and being transferred to the data analysis sector, she still remembers this clearly and establishes good personal relationships with the experimental subjects. She has been searching for ways to alleviate the pain of death until today.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Secretary_Ranger.title: Ranger Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Secretary_Ranger.descripti: [PAWN_nameDef] is a field worker of Secretary Nexus, that means she is a ranger secretary who walks for a long time in the wilderness of rimworld, deals with local people and wildlife, explores and maps the terrain and landforms of rimworld. For most of her past time, [PAWN_nameDef] lived in the wilderness, only when passing by the settlements can one see people other than ranger secretaries. Her experience of surviving in the wilderness has equipped her with extremely rich skills, knowing the habits of local creatures, treating common injuries and illnesses, speaking local dialects, and shooting accurately. She was therefore considered a priority candidate to become a caravan guard.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Commissar.title: Commissar Secretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Commissar.description: Yes, [PAWN_nameDef] was a commissar secretary serving in the Alfau Militia. She has charged at the head of her men countless times on countless battlefields, set an example for the mortal through deeds. She has patrolled trenches and camps countless nights, listened to the troubles and pains of the soldiers, heard and told the soldiers what to fight for. She has charged at the forefront, she has held the most fragile defense line, she has covered the retreat with fearless volunteers like her. She was the last one to leave the trench. She has listened to so many, encouraged so many, comforted so many, and attempted to save so many, so many see her face at the last moment of their lives. So when she was alone, countless names, families, stories, and promises rose and fell in her mind, make her suffering. She told herself a long time ago not to think too much, just to fulfill each promise and unfulfilled wishes one by one, everything will be a distant memory. \n\nBut now she is too far away from those promises and wishes, the cold void and blazing stars separated her, the soldiers, and the people they longed for. In the rimworld, she has met so many again, although they are not her soldiers, but their stories and wishes have also become part of her bottomless list. One day, when she is finally able to leave this planet, she will have the opportunity to remove the stones weighing down on her heart one by one.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Battlefield_Ghost.title: Battlefield Ghosecretary
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Battlefield_Ghost.descript: [PAWN_nameDef] woke up from the darkness again and again, marched to battlefields again and again, bandaged her own wounds again and again, bled again and again, and fell into darkness again and again. [PAWN_nameDef] has died many times in wars of Alfaus, even her dreams are filled with blood, bones, fire, steel, and buzzing. Such torture is enough to drive mortals into madness, but with the mental protection system, she can still calmly recall the cause, surroundings and feeling of her last death. She knows the operation of all weapons and the correct treatment methods for all wounds like the back of her hand, she can even make the most effective disinfectants and antidotes using materials found everywhere in the wild. Citizens see her as an angel of death and salvation, soldiers regarded her as their most reliable comrade in arms, she is the most suitable confidant and who you can rely on the most. Secretary Nexus stores the valuable experience she uploaded, libraries are filled with novels and reference books written with her materials, her contributions made with her blood are remembered by many, but when she wakes up from nightmares, few can be confided in and comfort her.\n\nPerhaps one day, she will meet someone who can understand and comfort her, someone is also experiencing eternal nightmares, who can accompany her and encourage her to continue moving forward. She is not alone on Secretary Nexus, but in the rimworld, only comrades who can be touched are reliable.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Standard_Clone.title: Standard Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Standard_Clone.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a secretary clone made, trained and implanted for serving Alfau citizens, filled with implants, knowledge, and ideology serving the great purpose. Before leaving the incubation tank, she had already been given the skills and habits needed to understand, respond, appease, and motivate others. No matter what she has experienced in the past or what she will experience in the future, she will always display the perfect and just right expression as designed when talking to others, and discover the true points from the speeches of others, whether short or long. Although she may not realize.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Military_Clone.title: Military Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Military_Clone.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born for military purposes of Alfaus. Her nerves and muscles, everything within has been adjusted to face the most intense battles and to receive, convey, and issue orders. Her gun holding posture can rival that of the most disciplined army even on the day she left the incubation tank.\n\nFor her, the skill of killing others is innate, fighting and shooting are innate muscle memories, before she realized what she has done, the bullet has already been fired and the blade has already been swung out. Others can only guess if she felt sad when she first realized that her role is designed for killing.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Industrial_Clone.title: Industry Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Industrial_Clone.descripti: [PAWN_nameDef] was born in the fire of Alfau's industry, and came back to the fire of Alfau's industry. From the Alfau Peninsula to the stars, The things Alfaus brought with are not only alfalfa and carrots, but countless machines, blast furnaces, and steel frames. The demand for industry in interstellar colonization is incalculable.\n\nEven before secretaries left their homeland, secretaries born with the knowledge and skills required for production processes have spread throughout the Alfau Peninsula, and served for decades in countless great projects and endless industrial areas. Nowadays, they are just going further.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Outworker_Clone.title: Outworker Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Outworker_Clone.descriptio: [PAWN_nameDef] was given the skills and knowledge most suitable for working and surviving in the wilderness of rimworld. Exploring unfamiliar planets and effectively utilizing local resources is itself a daunting challenge. Colonizers not only have to face unknown environments and threats, but also have the ability to analyze local flora and fauna resources and minerals. Since being appointed as the vanguard of interstellar colonization, secretary clones designed for exploring unfamiliar world have landed on and left many habitable planets, left roads, foundations, power grids, mines, and other developed infrastructures behind. They were born to face wilderness, leave civilization.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Agriculture_Clone.title: Agriculture Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Agriculture_Clone.descript: Although more efficient ways of nutrient intake have been invented, but for Alfaus, natural foods are obviously more acceptable. [PAWN_nameDef]'s gene model is designed for that. Before her first breath, she already knew how the animals on her home planet breathe, before her first walk, she already learned about the daily and nighttime habits of common crops and livestock. To explore the possibility of industrialization of alien creatures, she was also implanted with a set of research methods and logic by Secretary Nexus, that is used to analyze the structure, habits, and nutritional composition of unfamiliar beings. All of this enables her to effectively adjust agricultural production on an unfamiliar planet based on the features of alien flora and fauna，and treat their injuries and illnesses according to medical theory. Relying on agriculture secretary like [PAWN_nameDef], the hundreds of star systems under governance of the Progressive International can be supported to maintain a large population with healthy mind and body.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Researcher_Clone.title: Researcher Clone
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Researcher_Clone.descripti: [PAWN_nameDef]'s artificial brain is not implanted with professional knowledge and skills like other secretaries, but filled with scientific principles and philosophical logic. Her purpose is not to directly work or serve others, but to utilize the massive data and information collected by Secretary Nexus through the practice of production and service to explore the future of production and service. In other words, explore the objective laws of the material world through the practical experience of production uploaded by other secretaries, and invent better production machines and services. Although secretaries can easily talk with each other on Secretary Nexus and share experiences, but in order to balance work and research efficiency, researcher secretaries like [PAWN_nameDef] are still needed, so the time invested in research can be continuous and sufficient.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Consciousnessless.title: Consciousnessless
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_Consciousnessless.descript: This is a consciousnessless body with no story to tell.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_SpecialSecretary_KitchenMa: [PAWN_nameDef] is renowned throughout the Alfaus settlements for culinary skills. Many clans have applied to have her stationed in their communes just to taste her cooking — it's said her work orders are already booked for the next decade. As a result, she keeps traveling from one settlement to another, bringing delicious and safe meals to countless Alfaus and residents of other races. Her fame spreads farther with each journey, and even the clans settled on the rimworld have tried to invite her to stay with them.
LanguageData.SEC_Backstory_SpecialSecretary_Killa.des: How to become the most stylish bunny on the battlefield? [PAWN_nameDef] has her own answer: gear must look cool, moves must be fast, do it yourself, and follow the trend. Although the Secretary Nexus tacitly allows secretaries to personalize their standard equipment, what [PAWN_nameDef] has done goes far beyond what her sisters could ever imagine. She seems to care nothing about stealth, maintainability, low recognizability, or any of the usual considerations in military equipment design. She paints highly individual graffiti on her armor and guns, attaches all kinds of attachments, welds pointless spikes and crude armor plates, and compensates for the disadvantages brought by her pursuit of fashion with combat experience and skill. She aspires to become the most conspicuous bunny on the battlefield, to be remembered by everyone across the galaxy unlike her other sisters in arms who remain unknown, moving from one battlefield to another and being gradually forgotten.
